title: Leading term of a multi-twisted Euler characteristic via top-dimensional components
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], let $X$ be a proper scheme over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism], let $\mathcal F$ be a nonzero coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module [pqf-def-coherent], and let $\mathcal L_1,\ldots,\mathcal L_r$ be invertible $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-sc-invertible-module]. Let $d=\dim\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$ [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], let $Z_1,\ldots,Z_s$ be the irreducible components of $\operatorname{Supp}(\mathcal F)$ of dimension $d$ [def-weil-irreducible-components], each with its reduced induced integral closed-subscheme structure $\iota_i:Z_i\hookrightarrow X$ [def-pc-integral-scheme] [def-weil-closed-immersion], let $\xi_i$ be the generic point of $Z_i$ [def-sc-generic-point], and put $m_i=\mathrm{length}_{\mathcal O_{X,\xi_i}}(\mathcal F_{\xi_i})$ [def-weil-pbc-module-length]. Then each $m_i$ is a positive integer, and $(n_1,\ldots,n_r)\mapsto\chi(X,\mathcal F\otimes\mathcal L_1^{\otimes n_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathcal L_r^{\otimes n_r})-\sum_{i=1}^s m_i\,\chi(X,\iota_{i*}\mathcal O_{Z_i}\otimes\mathcal L_1^{\otimes n_1}\otimes\cdots\otimes\mathcal L_r^{\otimes n_r})$ [def-pc-euler-characteristic] is a numerical polynomial in $n_1,\ldots,n_r$ of total degree $<d$ (the zero polynomial when $d=0$).
